name: Travel Agency 5
definition: Travel agency component provides details of travel agency, airline, or railway transactions.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Contains an agency code or name.

IATACode.name: IATA Code
IATACode.definition: Contains the International Air Transport Association (IATA) code identifying the company that purchased the ticket.

ShortName.name: Short Name
ShortName.definition: Short name of the travel agency.

Contact.name: Contact
Contact.definition: Contact information related to the travel agency.

TravelPackage.name: Travel Package
TravelPackage.definition: Provides detailed information about the travel package, excluding specific itinerary data.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
